_comment: HELD-OUT CONSTITUTIVE LAW validation set. Identical to fvm_gen/gen_alternating.json except visc_model is pinned to NonMonotonic -- a fifth viscosity model the training corpus never contains -- and two specs are narrowed (see below). NonMonotonic thins toward visc_min_factor near gamma_dot ~ visc_gamma_scale and then JAMS, jumping by a factor of 10-40 over less than a decade of shear rate to a plateau A = 2 + 10*visc_n. All four trained models are MONOTONE in shear rate; none can dip and then rise, and none produces the order-of-magnitude viscosity contrast WITHIN one frame that this does (over the flow's own shear range, gamma_dot 5-200: Carreau spans a factor 2.7, this spans 17). That intra-frame contrast -- nearly inviscid where shear is low, effectively jammed where it is high -- is what makes the fields, not just the formula, out of distribution.
_context_note: Same hidden-physics resampling as training, with visc_model FIXED. The other context parameters still alternate per segment, so the data has the same structure the model was trained to read; only the law it must infer is new.

visc_n._note: NARROWED to <1. The mirror (gen_mirror.py --set visc_model=Carreau) reuses visc_n, and Carreau with n>1 is shear-THICKENING -- it would reach a high-shear factor of ~15 and stop being the monotone contrast the comparison needs. Below 1 the mirror is canonical shear-thinning Carreau (1.7 -> 0.3) against this law's 1 -> 0.7 -> 5..11. Still inside the training range.

visc_gamma_scale._note: NARROWED to the low end of the training range (which is 2-40). The thickening onset is 1.5*visc_gamma_scale, and the measured shear rate in these flows has median ~1-5 / p95 ~20-40, so an onset above ~10 leaves almost none of the fluid thickened and the law never shows up in the fields. At 2.5-5 about 28% of the domain jams.

viscosity._note: NARROWED to the lower part of the training range. Peak effective viscosity is mu*A with A up to ~46, and the jammed regions set the viscous stability limit; capping mu at 0.002 keeps mu*A <= 0.09, comparable to the stiffest training runs (0.06 * 1.7). The mirror, whose factor is <=1.7, stays well inside distribution.

_ic_note: Freestream/BC, sampled once per trajectory and held fixed across its segments. Copied verbatim from the training config.
